JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: A personal journal entry capturing an activity, event, or daily reflection with date, heading, detailed matter, attachments, location, and tags.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

heading.description: Title or heading of the journal entry or event (1-200 chars).

body.description: Detailed matter or full written reflection (0-20000 chars).

entryDateMillis.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds for the user-selected date of the activity or event.

category.description: Type of journal moment or event.

locationName.description: Human-readable place or venue name (0-200 chars).

locationLat.description: Optional latitude coordinate (-90 to 90), omitted when absent.

locationLng.description: Optional longitude coordinate (-180 to 180), omitted when absent.

tags.description: Bounded list of up to 10 string tags for organizing and filtering entries.

attachments.description: Bounded list of up to 10 attachment metadata maps (id, name, mimeType, localPath, kind, sizeBytes).

bookmarked.description: Whether the entry is bookmarked/pinned for quick revisit.

wordCount.description: Word count of heading and detailed body for journal insights.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every write.

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: User-scoped private collection of personal journal entries.
